title: Evidence Request
description: A declarative request the Reviewer's model emits for more evidence. The model never calls tools: the orchestrator validates each request (targets must resolve in the symbol index at the review's revision; unknown ops are rejected) and fulfils it with deterministic code. For run_tests the targets are symbols, never commands: rig selects the tests from the caller graph. At most one evidence round per unit.

question.description: The specific question the evidence should answer.

finding_ref.description: The hypothesis finding this evidence would confirm or refute.
